sources.transformation: Official polygons filtered by municipal code and requested in EPSG:4326; four municipality names normalized to English display names.
sources.limitations: This is a 1:1,000,000 generalized national statistical boundary product (not the city-scale survey boundary). It is not a neighborhood/district layer.

sources.dataset_name: HSL public transport static GTFS feed — boarding stops
sources.geographic_coverage: HSL source network; map subset within four core municipal polygons
sources.transformation: Extracted stops.txt and feed_info.txt only from HSL GTFS ZIP; retained GTFS location_type=0 boarding points inside the four municipal polygons; converted coordinates to GeoJSON longitude/latitude.
sources.limitations: The complete source archive is about 82 MB zipped and more than 1 GB expanded. It is downloaded only by ETL; only the 1.1 MB stops table is versioned. Mapped 6027 boarding stop records; excluded 2240 outside the four municipalities and 0 invalid coordinates. This static feed is refreshed daily by HSL, but a local checked-in snapshot is not live.

sources.period_covered: Live feed; feed timestamp returned with each response
sources.geographic_coverage: HSL region; client filters visible positions to the four municipal polygons
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (HSL open-data terms)
sources.transformation: Serverless same-origin proxy fetches the official GTFS-RT protobuf feed, decodes VehiclePosition entities and caches responses for 5 seconds.
sources.limitations: HSL documents vehicle position feeds at 1-second update intervals. Browser refresh is throttled to 15 seconds; proxy cache is 5 seconds. The server-side probe snapshot is an observation from one retrieval, not a permanent availability guarantee. An empty or failed future response is not represented as zero.
sources.record_count_context: VehiclePosition entities in the last server-side probe; positions are not persisted locally.
